info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Create P2m Qr Payment Request-spec
info.description: The P2M QR Payment Request API enables businesses to generate QR codes for person-to-merchant payments. By utilizing this API, merchants can easily create unique QR payment requests that facilitate cashless transactions, enhancing customer satisfaction and streamlining payment processes. Typical consumers include retail businesses looking to offer modern payment options and service providers aiming to simplify billing. This API plays a vital role in promoting efficiency and innovation within payment ecosystems.

post.summary: Create a new QR payment request.
post.description: This endpoint allows users to generate a new QR payment request. Upon successful creation, it returns the details of the generated QR payment request that can be used for processing payments.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to initiate a QR payment request. The client must provide the necessary data in JSON format to successfully create a payment request.

outletId.description: Identifier for the specific outlet associated with the merchant.

terminalId.description: Identifier for the terminal processing the payment.

mode.description: Mode of the transaction, such as 'test' or 'live'.

amount.description: The amount of money to be charged for the payment.

merchantOrderId.description: Unique identifier for the order from the merchant's perspective.

tipOptions.description: Options for tips that may be added to the transaction.

expiresAt.description: Date and time when the payment request expires.

singleUse.description: Indicates whether the payment request can be used only once.

requestContext.description: Contextual information related to the request.
